checkout.summary: Use 4011 for loose yellow bananas that are weighed at checkout.

visualCues: Slender curved fingers joined at one crown
Bright yellow peel, sometimes with small brown speckles
Shorter and slimmer than a plantain

storyBeats.label: Family
storyBeats.copy: Recognize the banana family before deciding which kind it is.

storyBeats.label: Shape
storyBeats.copy: The fingers are slimmer and more rounded than plantains.

storyBeats.label: Color
storyBeats.copy: The standard checkout listing is the familiar yellow dessert banana.

storyBeats.label: Sold
storyBeats.copy: Place the bunch on the scale; do not count each banana separately.

codeRelations.title: Organic keeps the same four digits
codeRelations.copy: Loose yellow banana is 4011. The organic listing shown in the source is 94011.

codeRelations.title: Plantain is a different lookup
codeRelations.copy: Plantain belongs to the same broad family but uses 4235.

nearestConfusion.name: Plantain
nearestConfusion.cue: Plantains are usually longer, thicker, firmer, and more angular.

similarItems.name: Plantain
similarItems.cue: Longer, thicker, and more angular than a yellow banana.

similarItems.name: Baby banana
similarItems.cue: Much smaller fingers, even when fully ripe.
